fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM93,760. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057854/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: A pass in STPM with at least Grade C (GP 2.0) in any TWO subjects*; A pass in STAM with at least Grade Jayyid*; Matriculation or Foundation with at least CGPA of 2.00; A Diploma (Level 4, MQF) with at least CGPA of 2.00; An Advanced Diploma (Level 5, MQF) with at least CGPA of 2.00; A Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM) / Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) subjected to HEP Senate / Academic Board’s approval***; A Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (DLKM) subjected to HEP Senate / Academic Board’s approval***; Note for (vi) & (vii): The HEPs are to conduct screening and provide necessary guidance specific to the discipline of the programme. Other equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government. Additional requirement: A pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level or equivalent qualifications. International Students: Required to achieve a minimum score of 6.0 for IELTS OR its equivalent.
